```plato
    //==
    // # KdTree2D — k nearest neighbors
    //
    // The rank of point i is how many points come strictly before it, ordering by
    // distance and breaking ties by stored index so the order is total and the
    // ranks are a permutation. The r-th result is then the point whose rank is r.

    // True when point j comes before point i: nearer, or equally near and
    // earlier in the point array.
    NeighborPrecedes(self: KdTree2D, center: Point2D, j: Integer, i: Integer): Boolean {
        var dj = self.Points[j].DistanceSquared(center);
        var di = self.Points[i].DistanceSquared(center);
        return dj < di || dj == di && j < i;
    }
```
